overview: A reviewed end-to-end design covering integration patterns, security boundary, ownership and failure management. The scope is built around asset inventories, detections and incident operating procedures, producing prioritised security controls, findings and rehearsed response. A customer-named ciso delegate approves the work. The service-specific assurance focus is false positives, privileged access and evidence chain.
